description: Manage webhook, email, mock API, file, authenticator, vault, test payment and mock MCP resources through HTTP lifecycle routes. Authenticators support create, inspect, list, update (name) and delete only; use them only for accounts your human asked you to create or operate. Use calls for mock history. Forward accepts config.url with optional method and path. Replay accepts config.requestId, config.url and config.idempotencyKey. Deliveries reads the resulting attempts. Email supports create, inspect, delete and renew; mail reading stays private.
name: resource_request
